# Authored Xiongnu royal yurt source

This production mesh is materialized from the artist-authored Xiongnu royal yurt geometry used by Delenda Est.

- Repository: `JustusAvramenko/delenda_est`
- Immutable revision: `7f1ed21fe909f3584b96ddcb874645fe3fe3776e`
- Source path: `art/meshes/structural/xion_royal_yurt.dae`
- Source Git blob: `f045bf6b43c093827653fd6f570d86193a1e376a`
- Artwork license: CC-BY-SA-3.0, as declared in upstream `Contributors and License.txt`
- Source format: Collada 1.4.1, Z_UP, Blender-authored metadata
- Source topology: 1,876 position vertices / 2,824 triangles
- Runtime compilation: source coordinates are recentered and converted from Z_UP to Y_UP; the exact authored triangles are split into body/roof material groups. The silhouette is not reconstructed from primitives.
- Selection reason: unlike the previous `xion_house_b.dae`, this mesh has a circular lower body and a strongly tapering roof, so it remains recognizably yurt-shaped at the Village mobile camera distance.

Attribution: Delenda Est contributors. Upstream commit history states the Scythian/Xiongnu art set was mostly brought in from Terra Magna and adapted for Delenda Est.
